senses.definition: n.pr.loc. Gn 10:13 = 1 Ch 1:11 (𝔊 Νεφθαλ(ι)ειμ, but 𝔊L in Ch Νεφθωσειμ); = pʾtʾmḥï, the northern land, i.e. Lower Egypt, according to Brugsch Hierogl. WB. Suppl. 633, and especially Erman ZAW x (1890), 118, 119 reading פתמחים. Other conj. v. Di Gn.
